description: API rate limit planner — Turn one or more API rate limits into a safe request plan: binding limit, sustained rate, minimum spacing between calls, concurrency needed (Little's law), token-bucket refill and capacity, per-worker split, and how long a job of N requests takes. Params: limit (required) either a number with window= seconds or 1m/1h/1d, or a list like 60/1m;1000/1h;10000/1d; requests total jobs; latency avg ms (default 200); concurrency max in flight; workers (default 1); safety fraction of each limit to use (default 0.9). Offline. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_rate_limit_plan
